d:
Enjoy the soulful track "Naina" in stunning 8K quality from the film Crew. Sung by Diljit Dosanjh featuring Badshah, this beautiful song is composed by Raj Ranjodh with heartfelt lyrics by Raj Ranjodh & Badshah.
Starring Tabu, Kareena Kapoor Khan, and Kriti Sanon, Naina brings together emotion, melody, and star power in one unforgettable experience.
Song Details :
Song Name - Naina
Album Name - Crew
Music Composer - Raj Ranjodh
Singers - Diljit Dosanjh Ft. Badshah
Lyrics - Raj Ranjodh & Badshah
